column1: # note: Form IT-40 line 8: "State adjusted gross income tax: multiply line 7 by 3% (.03)." A flat rate, so one bracket for each filing status. Indiana prints no tax table.
# note: The IT-40 booklet says amounts must be rounded to the nearest whole dollar (booklet PDF page 5, Rounding Required); the test rounds line 8 so.
# note: County tax (line 9, Schedule CT-40) is not covered.
# note: Hand-transcribed from the PDF and checked against its text twice.
